«b|❯» «b,rev,u|/»«b,rev|help       Show commands and keyboard shortcuts»
  «b|/»clear      Clear the conversation and start a new session
  «b|/»compact    Compact the conversation (optional focus instructions)
  «b|/»model      Switch the model for this session
  «b|/»rewind     Restore the code and/or conversation to an earlier point
